messages.subject: Ashfield Dynamics Ltd v Marwick Drives Ltd - Letter Before Action
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

We act for Ashfield Dynamics Limited. Please find attached our letter before action concerning the supply of 60 MD-450 gearmotor units under PO-AD-4471. As set out, our client's losses currently stand at £418,500.

We should be grateful for a substantive response within 21 days, and for the details of your client's insurers. Our client is open to mediation.

Yours sincerely
Tom Gallagher
Senior Associate, Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: Dear Mr Gallagher, We act for Marwick Drives Limited. Liability is denied. Our client's position is
messages.subject: RE: Ashfield Dynamics Ltd v Marwick Drives Ltd - Letter Before Action
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We act for Marwick Drives Limited. Liability is denied. Our client's position is that the units were fit for purpose and that the failures, if established, were caused by your client's misalignment on installation, overloading and inadequate maintenance. In any event our client relies on clause 11 of its conditions of sale, which caps liability at the price of the affected units and excludes consequential loss.

We will respond more fully in due course but your client should not assume the claim will be met.

Yours sincerely
Alistair Whitlock
Pemberton Rowe LLP
